titleBox.en: When a Wellness Coach Falls Apart

captions.en: Hi, I'm Soaming, founder of Soaming Lab.
Since starting Soaming Lab and a new journey in July,
yesterday, for the first time, my heart just collapsed.
I started this because I loved it, yet I wondered: is this right?
There was impatience, and uncertainty too.
Many founders who left a steady paycheck for business
have probably gone through this too.
I lived on a salary too, and now that I'm forging a new path,
anxiety and worry about each day follow me.
Thankfully, trusted relationships have led to connections,
and chances to try new things keep coming,
but my vision and dreams are so big,
and while preparing, I ask how to get through each day.

captions.small: 오늘 하루도 내 마음을 지키는 게
captions.en: I realized how important it is to guard my heart, today too.

captions.big:
정작 제 웰니스는
못 챙기고 있었어요
captions.en: I run a wellness business, yet I wasn't caring for my own wellness.
For months, I haven't slept properly,
and worry and anxiety have worn down my body.
If I can't do wellness myself, how can I share it with others?

captions.small: 제 마음을 지키고, 제 웰니스를 잘해야
captions.en: I need to guard my heart and my wellness to pass it on,
so first, I'll keep a healthy sleep routine,

captions.big:
사람들에게 좋은 에너지를
줄 수 있도록
captions.en: and lift my energy so I can give good energy to others.
I realized I have to become a clean channel first.
It's hard. I started this because I truly loved it,

captions.big:
이 길이 맞을까
계속 의문이 들기도 하고
captions.en: yet I keep asking if this is the right path.
I believe I was guided here,
but the thought that I must prove myself every day
really hurt me.
